verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rule engine in Oneleet that triggers actions on events. Related items do not qualify: daily scheduled code scans and Fieldwork running 'on your schedule' are recurring schedules, not event-triggered rules. Automatically added framework controls and the CI pull-request check are fixed built-in behaviors, and status-page email notifications are an adjacent alerting feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
